items.headline: Oscar Piastri ends long F1 podium drought after bizarre Las Vegas chaos | RacingNews365

sources.evidence_excerpt: Article To news overview © XPB Images Oscar Piastri returned to the F1 podium for the first time in six months after a chaotic Las Vegas Grand Prix.
evidence_excerpts: Article To news overview © XPB Images Oscar Piastri returned to the F1 podium for the first time in six months after a chaotic Las Vegas Grand Prix.
In the end, Norris got ahead to finish second, but Piastri was third over the line for his first F1 podium finish since third in May's Miami Grand Prix, 18 races ago.
It is his best finish since fourth in the Austrian GP in June after a tough run for the Australian - who also ended the longest podium drought of his career.
